destination.title: Scalar inflation: dynamics, construction, histories and conditional constraints
destination.question: How do scalar dynamics, field-space and kinetic structure, gravitational evolution and initial conditions shape inflation, its perturbations and conditional consistency tests?
destination.summary: A broad family containing distinct physical questions and methods. Numerical proximity does not establish scientific equivalence, universal exclusions or ultraviolet consistency.

systems: Canonical, noncanonical, dissipative and composite scalar models
targets: Inflationary expansion, scalar displacement and primordial perturbations
Potential construction, stabilization and predictive control
Initial conditions, selection, self-reproduction and cosmological transitions
Conditional tests of proposed quantum-gravity and scalar-interaction inequalities
regimes: Exact backgrounds and separately qualified slow-roll approximations
Cold, warm, turning, kinetic-driven and stochastic inflation
Source-specific spacetime dimensions, geometry and temporal phases
assumptions: Conjectures are conditional inputs where explicitly adopted
Source-parent graph relations do not automatically become premises of every retrieval facet
Passing selected inequalities does not establish a complete cosmological model or ultraviolet completion
conventions: Distinguish canonical displacement, coordinate variation, trajectory length and geodesic separation
Distinguish Hubble slow evolution from potential slow roll and slow scalar acceleration
Keep source-specific Planck conventions, conjecture branches and observational dates
includes: Distinct mechanisms sharing a broad question without sharing a fine identity
Boundary methods with explicit alternate homes
excludes: An accepted equivalence class of all numerical members
Universal inflationary exclusions inferred from restricted examples
A cosmological implication of a static radial bound without a supplied dictionary

sources.title: Constraints on the spectral index for the inflation models in string landscape

evidence.text: Can a scalar drive inflation through a canonical field excursion exceeding the Planck scale while remaining in the string landscape? The paper proposes a negative answer and tests selected constructions.

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Can one scalar sustain a nearly constant vacuum energy while a second scalar supplies an instability that ends inflation?

sources.title: Accidental Inflation in the Landscape

evidence.text: Can quantized flux scanning supply the potential tuning needed for accidental inflation, while predecessor vacua and bubble evolution provide suitable initial conditions? What inflationary distributions follow within this restricted landscape?

sources.title: $\alpha'$ Inflation: moduli stabilisation and observable tensors from higher derivatives

evidence.text: Can higher-derivative α′ corrections stabilize the remaining LVS flat directions while preserving the derivative expansion, and can one such direction support inflation with observable tensor modes?

sources.title: Modelling inflation with a power-law approach to the inflationary plateau

evidence.text: Can a canonically normalized single-field potential approaching an inflationary plateau by a power law fit the quoted observations, produce distinguishable tensor signals, and admit economical mass scales and supersymmetric toy realizations?

sources.title: Light scalars and the cosmos: Nambu–Goldstone and otherwise

evidence.text: Which light scalars can support inflation, and do observations or theoretical consistency require large-field inflation to be natural, chaotic, or axion monodromy? The talk reconsiders hybrid inflation as motion on a pseudomoduli space.

sources.title: The string swampland constraints require multi-field inflation

evidence.text: Do conjectured restrictions on field distance and potential steepness exclude inflation, or can a non-geodesic trajectory sustain slow expansion despite a steep total potential gradient?

sources.title: A note on Inflation and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a canonical potential with an exponentially flat positive plateau produce many e-folds without a large field excursion? The example has height V0 and a positive dimensionless steepness parameter q.

sources.title: Primordial Gravitational Waves and the Swampland

evidence.text: The analyzed inflationary regime has one canonical light field and uses potential slow-roll parameters to relate quantum-gravity inequalities to tensor production. Monotonic growth of ε lets a lower instantaneous field speed constrain the total field excursion.

sources.title: Draining the Swampland

evidence.text: Can an additional scalar provide the gradient required by C1 without controlling symmetry breaking, inflationary observables or present acceleration?

sources.title: Avoiding the string swampland in single-field inflation: Excited initial states

evidence.text: Can additional gravitational friction permit inflation on a steep canonical scalar potential without weakening the conjectured slope bound?

sources.title: Chaotic inflation on the brane and the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Can modified expansion in a braneworld support single-field slow-roll inflation with a small field excursion and an order-one potential slope while retaining acceptable scalar and tensor spectra?

sources.title: Chaotic inflation on the brane and the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Which changes to the perturbation source, inflationary dynamics, or initial state have been proposed to ease the conjectural constraints?

sources.title: Primordial Black Holes and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Can altered degrees of freedom, kinetic terms, initial states, or conjectural criteria evade the conventional scalar-power argument?

sources.title: Primordial Black Holes and the String Swampland

evidence.text: The inflationary setting translates restrictions on a scalar potential into restrictions on primordial perturbations through canonical single-field slow-roll relations.

sources.title: Learning to Inflate

evidence.text: Can gradient ascent on inflationary e-folds efficiently generate random potentials with sufficient inflation, and what potential shapes and observable distributions emerge along the optimization trajectory?

sources.title: Modular Inflation at Higher Level $N$

evidence.text: Which shift-containing discrete subgroups enlarge the space of symmetry-constrained two-field inflationary potentials?

sources.title: Modular Inflation at Higher Level $N$

evidence.text: Can a positive covariant-gradient lower bound coexist with slow-roll modular inflation and its tensor predictions?

sources.title: Rapid-Turn Inflationary Attractors

evidence.text: Can rapid-turn inflation satisfy a conjectural small-excursion requirement together with either a steep potential or a sufficiently negative Hessian eigenvalue?

sources.title: Primordial black hole tower: Dark matter, earth-mass, and LIGO black holes

evidence.text: Can a coupled effective potential realize successive inflationary phases and independent small-scale perturbation peaks?

sources.title: A Tip for Landscape Riders: Multi-Field Inflation Can Fulfill the Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: How does the length of a constant-latitude field trajectory compare with geodesic separation when both connect the same angular endpoints? The comparison holds the endpoint latitude fixed while varying the angular excursion.

sources.title: Eternal Inflation, Entropy Bounds and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can stochastic uphill motion evade scalar-potential constraints without violating a horizon-entropy bound, and can a region leaving that regime subsequently produce sufficient expansion and acceptable cosmological perturbations?

sources.title: Fat inflatons, large turns and the $\eta$-problem

evidence.text: The setting tests which properties of a scalar potential and its trajectory are required for inflation without presupposing a light potential-Hessian eigenvalue.

sources.title: Topological Eternal Hilltop Inflation and the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: The baseline asks when Hubble damping allows a scalar to roll slowly and how its potential predicts inflationary observables. The expansion law links potential derivatives to the dynamical conditions for slow roll.

sources.title: Swampland implications of GW170817-compatible Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity

evidence.text: How much scalar motion does tensor production require over an inflationary interval, and can that motion remain below an order-one distance bound?

sources.title: Non-canonical kinetic structures in the swampland

evidence.text: Small ε describes quasi-de Sitter expansion, while small η permits persistent inflation. These conditions constrain the expansion history without requiring a shallow potential or automatically negligible scalar acceleration.

sources.title: Swampland Constraints on No-Boundary Quantum Cosmology

evidence.text: Can enlarging the integration domain of a nearly constant no-boundary probability density favor inflation when many approximately symmetric scalar directions are available?

sources.title: Swampland Constraints on No-Boundary Quantum Cosmology

evidence.text: How do finite plateau width and the characteristic field-range parameter α affect compatibility between no-boundary inflation and the conjectural gradient, curvature and distance limits?

sources.title: Two-field inflationary model and swampland de Sitter conjecture

evidence.text: The setting describes inflation driven by the combined energy of two canonical scalar fields. A flat FRW background reduces the gravitational dynamics to relations between H, the total scalar kinetic energy and the potential.

sources.title: Further Refining Swampland Conjecture on Inflation in General Scalar-Tensor Theories of Gravity

evidence.text: Can E-model, T-model, and quantum-corrected scalar-tensor inflation satisfy conjectured restrictions on the slope and curvature of a positive scalar potential?

sources.title: Constraints on the spectral index for the inflation models in string landscape

evidence.text: Integrate the proposed trajectory, restrict its parameters, differentiate to reconstruct η and ξ, and evaluate the spectral formulas. Keep the trajectory family, endpoint prescription and slow-roll truncation explicit when comparing resulting bounds.

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Specify component equations of state and initial densities, integrate conservation separately, sum densities, and integrate the Friedmann equation. Equality epochs follow by equating component densities rather than by assuming continued single-component dominance through the transition.

sources.title: Accidental Inflation in the Landscape

evidence.text: Integrate covariant two-field moduli equations coupled to FRW expansion. Sample initial positions near the inflection point in an open universe; the distribution calculation uses random positions rather than explicitly locating every parent minimum.

sources.title: $\alpha'$ Inflation: moduli stabilisation and observable tensors from higher derivatives

evidence.text: For inflation, the fibre modulus is canonically normalized through τ1 = exp(2φ/√3). The authors evaluate slow-roll parameters, integrate the e-fold count and impose the density-perturbation normalization, with n_s = 1 + 2η* − 6ε* and r = 16ε*.

sources.title: Modelling inflation with a power-law approach to the inflationary plateau

evidence.text: The SUSY toy construction uses W=S²(Φ₁²−Φ₂²)/(2m), combines F- and chosen D-term potentials, aligns Φ₁ and Φ₂, and minimizes along S. The local-SUSY extension introduces a minimal Kähler potential and approximates S as sub-Planckian.

sources.title: Light scalars and the cosmos: Nambu–Goldstone and otherwise

evidence.text: Reviews supersymmetric effective-field-theory constructions using W=I(κφ²−μ²), logarithmic quantum corrections along the classically flat inflaton direction, and higher-dimension Kähler and superpotential operators to assess slow roll and tuning.

sources.title: Non-canonical kinetic structures in the swampland

evidence.text: DBI supplies a motivated example in which a relativistic speed limit permits inflation on potentials too steep for canonical slow roll. The paper tests the associated potential-gradient estimate.

sources.title: Topological inflation

evidence.text: Can topology keep a scalar field near a potential maximum and thereby permit new-type inflation without finely tuned initial field configurations?

sources.title: A note on Inflation and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can observations exclude inflation through proposed field-range and potential-slope criteria without establishing the source of the final curvature perturbation or the numerical strength of the slope criterion?

sources.title: Implications of single field inflation in general cosmological scenarios on the nature of dark energy given the swampland conjectures

evidence.text: How do scalar inflation and quintessence constraints change when the background expansion relation is F(H)=ρtot/3 rather than H²=ρtot/3? The paper varies the background function while retaining ordinary canonical scalar dynamics.

sources.title: Conditions for (No) Eternal Inflation

evidence.text: Which local features of a positive scalar potential allow inflationary volume to grow indefinitely, even when an individual region usually exits inflation?

sources.title: Generic 3-point statistics with tensor modes in light of Swampland and Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a tensor-scalar-scalar response reveal spatial diffeomorphism breaking during inflation? The source adds spatial ruler backgrounds to its clock description and studies the resulting mixed interaction.

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship conjecture from the swampland distance conjecture

evidence.text: How does a scalar-field excursion translate into accumulated expansion? The paper uses d-dimensional Friedmann evolution and, for a positive potential, a slow-roll relation between the potential slope and the scalar velocity.

sources.title: S-dual inflation and the string swampland

evidence.text: How much accelerated expansion does a canonical scalar produce before inflation ends? Exact background evolution depends on both the potential and initial velocity.

sources.title: The Convex Hull Swampland Distance Conjecture and Bounds on Non-geodesics

evidence.text: Can integrating out heavy scalars change which trajectories are geodesic and thereby change whether a light-field EFT appears to satisfy the SDC?

sources.title: Avoiding the string swampland in single-field inflation: Excited initial states

evidence.text: Can the scalar responsible for steep-potential inflation become subdominant after inflation and later drive accelerated expansion?

sources.title: Positive curvature and scalar field tunneling in the landscape

evidence.text: Can semiclassical scalar-field tunneling from a spherical ancestor produce inflation with residual positive spatial curvature, preserving the ancestral geometry sufficiently to counter claims that positive curvature would falsify a landscape origin?

sources.title: Composite inflation and further refining dS swampland conjecture

evidence.text: A finite-color deformation of the SYM-inspired composite potential is used to assess changes in inflationary observables.

sources.title: Warm tachyon inflation and swampland criteria

evidence.text: Test selected trajectories against conjectural excursion and slope inequalities, while distinguishing the tachyon coordinate from the canonically normalized scalar in the reviewed cold-inflation comparison.

sources.title: Geometrical scalar back-reaction effects in inflation

evidence.text: Can retained geometrical boundary contributions generate scalar and tensor spacetime waves during cold and warm inflation, and how does radiation affect their evolution?

sources.title: Small field models with gravitational wave signature supported by CMB data

evidence.text: Can fifth-degree small-field inflationary potentials produce r around 0.001 while matching scalar tilt and running, and how reliably do standard analytic approximations identify acceptable models?

sources.title: Swampland, axions, and minimal warm inflation

evidence.text: Which conjectural restrictions on scalar potentials, field-space excursion, and primordial fluctuation histories are imposed on the inflationary examples?

sources.title: k - inflation

evidence.text: Can nonquadratic scalar kinetic terms, without a potential, generate expanding Einstein-frame inflation with decreasing curvature, acceptable scalar perturbations and a graceful transition to a radiation-dominated universe?

sources.title: Completely dark matter from rapid-turn multifield inflation

evidence.text: Can explicit angular forcing sustain rapid-turn inflation in flat field space while a modified potential provides a post-inflationary minimum?

sources.title: Bounding field excursions along null geodesics with applications to cosmology

evidence.text: How does gravitational focusing constrain scalar displacement along null geodesics, and what does this imply for inflationary field ranges, landscape exploration, and possible semiclassical extensions?

sources.title: The Convex Hull Swampland Distance Conjecture and Bounds on Non-geodesics

evidence.text: Does one scalar measure of bending characterize SDC-compatible trajectories when different hyperbolic factors and growth sectors are available?

sources.title: Spinodal solution to swampland inflationary constraints

evidence.text: Does a potential-slope restriction exclude inflation when non-equilibrium fluctuations control the evolution? The authors propose assessing the relevant slope safety through the potential-driven stage.

sources.title: Assisted inflation

evidence.text: Can multiple scalar fields with individually steep exponential potentials cooperate through cosmic expansion to produce inflation, and what scaling attractor and curvature-perturbation spectrum result when their slopes differ?

sources.title: A note on Inflation and the Swampland

evidence.text: How do the potential slope and canonical field displacement relate to inflationary expansion? The baseline is a single canonical inflaton background, with kinetic slow-roll parameter εH and potential approximation εV.

sources.title: Note on single-field inflation and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Can single-field inflation satisfy conjectural quantum-gravity restrictions on its potential while reproducing a small tensor-to-scalar ratio and a nearly scale-invariant scalar spectrum?

sources.title: Rejuvenating the hope of a swampland consistent inflated multiverse with tachyonic inflation in the high-energy RS-II braneworld

evidence.text: The reviewed problem is whether inflation can simultaneously produce sufficient expansion and acceptable perturbations while obeying conjectural limits on scalar displacement, potential derivatives and horizon-entropy loss.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Can a periodic scalar support a smooth inflationary potential over a canonical distance exceeding M_P while remaining insensitive to higher-dimension operators? The benchmark uses a protected perturbative shift symmetry and a dominant nonperturbative first harmonic.

sources.title: Seed models in scalar field cosmology

evidence.text: Can extrema of scalar-field variation restrict and relate canonical single-field Einstein-gravity cosmologies, test their inflationary predictions, and organize their post-inflationary evolution into seed models for modified gravity?

sources.title: Further Refining Swampland Conjecture on Inflation in General Scalar-Tensor Theories of Gravity

evidence.text: Can a parameter triple that works at one inflationary point satisfy the same conjecture throughout the displayed potential's positive domain?

sources.title: Initial conditions for inflation — A short review

evidence.text: How restrictive are initial conditions for scalar-field inflation, particularly after allowing matter and metric inhomogeneities, and why do assessments of inflation's likelihood differ?

sources.title: Scalar field inflation driven by a modification of the Heisenberg algebra

evidence.text: Can deformations of the Heisenberg algebra, implemented through classical Poisson brackets, support scalar-field inflation with an arbitrary starting potential, including exact exponential expansion and weaker potential slow-roll restrictions?

sources.title: Composite inflation and further refining dS swampland conjecture

evidence.text: A nonminimally coupled composite NJL scalar is used to generate a plateau inflationary potential.

sources.title: Reconstructing $k$-essence: Unifying the attractor $n_S(N)$ and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Study inflation driven by one scalar whose quadratic kinetic term has a field-dependent coefficient. The theory retains the Einstein gravitational action and introduces two unknown functions, V(φ) and L(φ).

sources.title: Scalar Weak Gravity Conjecture in Super Yang-Mills Inflationary Model

evidence.text: Can any inflationary potential satisfy all considered conjectural constraints across its full relevant domain, rather than only on selected intervals?

sources.title: Cosmological consequences of a principle of finite amplitudes

evidence.text: Can R+R² scalar inflation remain dominant toward a small-volume anisotropic past?

sources.title: Swampland conjecture and inflation model from brane perspective

evidence.text: How does a quadratic energy-density correction to the expansion rate alter single-field inflation? The parameter Λ sets the crossover between the ordinary Friedmann behavior and the brane-dominated regime.

sources.title: S-dual inflation and the string swampland

evidence.text: Can removing a power-law wall reduce the preference for inflationary paths away from the observationally favored plateau?

sources.title: Relating the scalar weak gravity conjecture and the swampland distance conjecture for an accelerating universe

evidence.text: How strongly do the original and revised scalar interaction inequalities constrain positive potentials approaching an inflationary plateau?

sources.title: Reconstructing $k$-essence: Unifying the attractor $n_S(N)$ and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Test whether the reconstructed inflationary functions satisfy conjectural restrictions on scalar displacement and potential steepness. The source applies these inequalities directly to φ despite its field-dependent kinetic coefficient.

sources.title: Composite inflation and further refining dS swampland conjecture

evidence.text: A composite scalar associated with strongly interacting N=1 SU(Nc) Yang-Mills theory supplies the effective inflaton.

sources.title: Composite inflation and further refining dS swampland conjecture

evidence.text: The models describe scalar-driven inflation in four-dimensional gravity, with composite microscopic origins represented by effective scalar potentials.

sources.title: Hyperinflation generalised: from its attractor mechanism to its tension with the ‘swampland conditions’

evidence.text: Determine which geometric, potential and initial-condition assumptions are essential for rapid-turn inflation, and whether relaxing them permits models compatible with scalar observations and the particular quantum-gravity conjectures examined in the paper.

sources.title: Revisiting Scalar Tensor inflation by swampland criteria and Reheating

evidence.text: Do the observationally selected inflationary examples also obey the paper's conjectural limits on field excursion and potential slope? These cuts are applied as additional conditions on model parameters.

sources.title: On the Field Excursion Bound

evidence.text: What enforces the flat FRW scalar field excursion bound, when can it saturate, and how robust is it to inflationary fluctuations, higher-derivative kinetics and spatial curvature?

sources.title: Constraints on the spectral index for the inflation models in string landscape

evidence.text: Can landscape inflation evade the small-tensor conclusion by using a different mechanism? The paper identifies successive vacuum tunnelling as an alternative outside its slow-roll field-budget calculation.

sources.title: Reconstructing $k$-essence: Unifying the attractor $n_S(N)$ and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Determine whether a scalar inflation model can reproduce a prescribed spectral-index attractor while obeying assumed bounds on field excursion and potential slope. The unknown functions are the potential and the coefficient of the scalar kinetic term.

sources.title: Hilltop inflation

evidence.text: Determine how generic hilltop inflation is as observable inflation or an earlier initial phase, its tensor signatures, and whether it alleviates potential-flatness tuning and initial-condition problems.

sources.title: Further Refining Swampland Conjecture on Inflation in General Scalar-Tensor Theories of Gravity

evidence.text: The framework asks how restrictions motivated by quantum gravity constrain scalar potentials used for cosmological inflation.

sources.title: Swampland distance conjecture, inflation and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: Which kinetic and potential structures make inflationary observables insensitive to a range of model details?

sources.title: Swampland Constraints on No-Boundary Quantum Cosmology

evidence.text: Can many nearly flat scalar directions overcome the small no-boundary weight for inflation without requiring an extremely large inflationary volume?

sources.title: A Tip for Landscape Riders: Multi-Field Inflation Can Fulfill the Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: The setting describes inflation driven by several scalar coordinates whose kinetic terms define a curved field space. Background trajectories and distances depend on this metric, while perturbations probe both its curvature and the potential.

sources.title: Constraints on the spectral index for the inflation models in string landscape

evidence.text: How does the canonical inflaton trajectory determine the inflationary expansion? The paper uses a spatially flat homogeneous background and counts e-folds backward from the end of inflation, with a monotonic field trajectory.

sources.title: Eternal Inflation and Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can self-reproducing inflation coexist with a finite effective-theory field range and a lower bound on the gradient of a positive scalar potential? The paper studies this compatibility conditionally, with explicit calculations for one slowly rolling inflaton.

sources.title: Constraints on the spectral index for the inflation models in string landscape

evidence.text: Can a Wilson-line scalar acquire a large canonical normalization scale through a small four-dimensional gauge coupling? The extranatural-inflation example makes this possibility explicit before gravitational consistency restrictions are applied.

sources.title: The Convex Hull Swampland Distance Conjecture and Bounds on Non-geodesics

evidence.text: How much can a light-field trajectory depart from a vertical infinite-distance geodesic in a hyperbolic scalar manifold?

sources.title: Gauss–Bonnet Inflation and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Can a scalar-dependent curvature coupling change inflationary observables enough to accommodate a steep potential and a small field excursion?

Can extrema of scalar-field variation restrict and relate canonical single-field Einstein-gravity cosmologies, test their inflationary predictions, and organize their post-inflationary evolution into seed models for modified gravity?

Determine how generic hilltop inflation is as observable inflation or an earlier initial phase, its tensor signatures, and whether it alleviates potential-flatness tuning and initial-condition problems.
Can topology keep a scalar field near a potential maximum and thereby permit new-type inflation without finely tuned initial field configurations?

destination.title: Bordism, topological charges and spacetime boundaries
destination.question: How do bordism and related topological structures classify physical backgrounds and charges, constrain defects, and organize spacetime boundaries and topology change?
destination.summary: The original packet supplies numerical memberships without a scientific region statement. Those memberships do not establish a shared mechanism, equivalent questions or universally vanishing bordism. This proposed region supports several related lines of inquiry, with explicit alternate homes for phase classification, interface spectra and formal sums over geometries.

systems: Fermionic SPT phases and Standard Model backgrounds as alternate classification settings
targets: Admissible background structures and topological charges
Defect content, microscopic realization and dynamical constraints
Spacetime endings, compactification and topology change
Bordism amplitudes and semiclassical transition weights
regimes: Source-specific dimensions, supersymmetry and tangential structures
Ordinary and pre-Swampland work remains eligible
assumptions: The Cobordism Conjecture is a conditional framework where invoked, not a verified premise shared by every source
Breaking and gauging apparent global charges are distinct possibilities
Restricted background categories need not have trivial bordism
conventions: Spacetime dimension and bordism degree remain distinct
Independent Spin structures and combined spin-duality structures are not interchangeable
Full non-Abelian monodromy data need not be retained by an Abelian bordism classification
A source-scoped singleton preserves the original question, including compound targets
includes: Mathematical classification, physical realization and dynamical tests as separate contributions
Useful alternate homes for sources outside the quantum-gravity defect core
excludes: A universal convergence theorem for iterative background completion
Automatic physical existence or stability from a nonzero bordism class
Identification of every topological charge with an ungauged global charge
A common canonical question inferred solely from numerical proximity

sources.title: Swampland cobordism conjecture and non-Abelian duality groups

evidence.text: Can a quantum-gravity connectedness requirement predict both which codimension-two defects exist and how their non-Abelian monodromies transform under exchange? Type IIB 7-branes test information that ordinary Abelian bordism may discard.

sources.title: Dynamical tadpoles, stringy cobordism, and the SM from spontaneous compactification

evidence.text: How do spatially varying solutions resolve dynamical tadpoles, and can their finite extent be understood through cobordism defects that trigger compactification, including to a semirealistic particle-physics model?

sources.title: Looking for structure in the cobordism conjecture

evidence.text: Can Whitehead towers, geometric structures, fluxes and defects make the unknown quantum-gravity bordism structure more concrete, and clarify the cobordism conjecture's gravity-decoupling limit?

sources.title: Dynamical cobordism of a domain wall and its companion defect 7-brane

evidence.text: Can singularities in the backreaction of a neutral, positive-tension, nonsupersymmetric domain wall be interpreted through dynamical cobordism, and can a suitable local ETW 7-brane solution supply the required endpoint defect?

sources.title: Dimensional Reduction of Cobordism and K-theory

evidence.text: Do cobordism and K-theory groups of a fixed compactification manifold X reproduce the charge lattices, symmetry breaking, and gauging expected under dimensional reduction, thereby supporting their proposed interpretation as higher-form charges?

sources.title: IIB string theory explored: Reflection 7-branes

evidence.text: Does including reflections in IIB duality require new non-supersymmetric 7-branes, and what can topology, probes and anomalies determine about their cores and worldvolume theories?

sources.title: Bordism for the 2-group symmetries of the heterotic and CHL strings

evidence.text: How does incorporating the B-field's 2-group structure change low-dimensional bordism for the heterotic and CHL strings, and what constraints on anomalies and defects follow?

sources.title: Aspects of dynamical cobordism in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How do known microscopic AdS5 end-of-the-world configurations realize dynamical cobordism in five dimensions, complete Karch–Randall branes with localized gravity, and extend to holographic theories with reduced supersymmetry?

sources.title: Cobordism and bubbles of anything in the string landscape

evidence.text: How can cobordism-motivated end-of-the-world (ETW) boundaries mediate vacuum decay to nothing or creation from nothing, and how do defect size and tension determine semiclassical transition exponents?

sources.title: The bubble of nothing under T-duality

evidence.text: How does the bubble of nothing (BoN), a dynamical cobordism ending spacetime by circle pinch-off, transform under T-duality? Does the growing dual circle describe spontaneous decompactification, or does the full string configuration still terminate spacetime?

sources.title: Intersecting end of the world branes

evidence.text: Can spacetime-dependent solutions with multiple scalars realize intersecting ETW branes, simultaneously probe intersecting infinite-distance field-space limits, and illuminate cobordism and Distance Conjecture constraints?

sources.title: Spin cobordism and the gauge group of type I/heterotic string theory

evidence.text: What are the spin cobordism groups of the classifying space of the actual type I/heterotic gauge group through dimension 12, and what nonperturbative charges and trivialization mechanisms might they describe?

sources.title: Cobordism Utopia: U-Dualities, Bordisms, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which topological charges arise from U-duality bundles in maximally supersymmetric supergravity, and which string-theoretic defects can remove them as required by the Cobordism Conjecture?

sources.title: Gliozzi-Scherk-Olive defects: IIA/IIB walls and the surprisingly stable R7-brane

evidence.text: How do long-string probes and target-space EFT characterize cobordism-predicted GSO walls and vortices, relate the IIA/IIB wall to R7-branes, and constrain their stability and D-brane charges?

sources.title: Reflection branes, bordisms, and <math display="inline"><mi>U</mi></math> dualities

evidence.text: How must U-duality groups be extended to act on fermions and accommodate internal reflections, and what non-supersymmetric codimension-two defects does twisted bordism predict?

sources.title: What IIB looks IIA string: string cobordisms via non-compact CFTs

evidence.text: Can noncompact worldsheet interpolations describe 0A/0B and IIA/IIB cobordism walls despite perturbative obstructions, and what do their infrared limits and brane probes reveal?

sources.title: Double fibration in G-theory and the cobordism conjecture

evidence.text: Can equations of motion and global-charge cancellation explain dynamical compactification in a G-theory double fibration, and does Spin bordism require additional defects beyond those canceling the cohomological tadpole?

sources.title: Brane networks and the cobordism conjecture

evidence.text: Which defects trivialize the H2(BG;Z) sector of two-dimensional bordism for discrete G, and how can codimension-two monodromy defects supply the codimension-three features expected from the Cobordism Conjecture?

sources.title: Gauge It or Break It: Lectures on Global Symmetries and the Cobordism Conjecture

evidence.text: How does the absence of exact global symmetries constrain quantum-gravity backgrounds, and what structures, defects and dynamical transitions does the Cobordism Conjecture require?

sources.title: Swampland cobordism conjecture and non-Abelian duality groups

evidence.text: Decompose a boundary twist into physical defect monodromies, attach branch cuts and track the changes when defects cross those cuts. The application reconstructs 7-brane braid transformations without discarding the full SL(2,Z) elements.

sources.title: Dynamical tadpoles, stringy cobordism, and the SM from spontaneous compactification

evidence.text: The analysis uses scalar effective actions, flux-sourced Laplace equations for warp factors, and proper-distance integrals. The KT five-dimensional description is a consistent truncation rather than a Wilsonian effective theory; AdS5 and T^{1,1} share a radius.

sources.title: Looking for structure in the cobordism conjecture

evidence.text: Stacks and simplicial presheaves describe geometric structures. Higher connections use the Dold–Kan construction on a Deligne complex and differential cohomology; geometric bordism groups are defined through a smooth bordism category.

sources.title: Dynamical cobordism of a domain wall and its companion defect 7-brane

evidence.text: Proper lengths, transverse area, curvature, and canonical field distance are evaluated in string and Einstein frames. Near-endpoint asymptotics are compared with proposed local dynamical-cobordism scaling relations.

sources.title: Dimensional Reduction of Cobordism and K-theory

evidence.text: Homological AHSS starts from E²_{p,q}=H_p(X;Ω_q^ξ(pt)); cohomological AHSS starts from E₂^{p,q}=H^p(X;K^q(pt)), or KO coefficients. Its limiting page determines an associated graded group, requiring separate extension information. Negative q must be retained for K-theory and Bott periodicity.

sources.title: IIB string theory explored: Reflection 7-branes

evidence.text: Compute circle-reduction anomaly inflow through one-loop Chern–Simons terms, using KK anomaly polynomials, regularized sums, η invariants and the APS index theorem.

sources.title: Cobordism Classes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does repeatedly restoring fields and defects lead to the complete allowed background category, and does its cobordism vanish?

sources.title: Black p-branes in heterotic string theory

evidence.text: Can black 0- and 4-brane supergravity solutions connect previously proposed heterotic-brane throat regions to asymptotically flat space, providing further evidence for the existence of the nonsupersymmetric branes suggested by cobordism arguments?

sources.title: Swampland cobordism conjecture and non-Abelian duality groups

evidence.text: Which codimension-two sources must be available to cap a circle carrying a nontrivial type IIB duality twist? The twist is a discrete bundle monodromy whose full group element contains more information than its bordism class.

sources.title: Bordisms between 9d type IIB supergravities and commutator widths of duality groups

evidence.text: How do duality monodromies constrain bordisms between circle-compactified gravitational theories, and can unbounded commutator width require more duality defects than ordinary first-bordism trivialization demands?

sources.title: Elementary Constituents Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the Cobordism Conjecture be strengthened dynamically: must there exist elementary defects trivializing bordism generators whose intrinsic tensions become nonnegative and at most Planckian somewhere in EFT field space, including for torsion charges without a classical extremal-black-hole comparison?

sources.title: At the end of the world: Local Dynamical Cobordism

evidence.text: Can spacetime endings motivated by the Cobordism Conjecture admit a universal local dynamical description, connecting singular scalar flows, microscopic defects and swampland constraints?

sources.title: End of the world brane networks for infinite distance limits in CY moduli space

evidence.text: Can dynamical cobordism solutions realize the infinite-distance divisors and their enhancements in fluxed Calabi–Yau fourfold complex-structure moduli space as spacetime networks of end-of-the-world (ETW) branes?

sources.title: Open-closed correspondence of K-theory and cobordism

evidence.text: Can open–closed string duality relate D-brane K-theory charges to geometric cobordism charges, and can gauging their combined charges explain familiar tadpole cancellation conditions?

sources.title: Cobordism Conjecture in AdS

evidence.text: Can the domain walls and end-of-the-world branes predicted by the cobordism conjecture exist in AdS when gravitational anomalies prohibit conformal interfaces or boundaries of the corresponding CFTs?

sources.title: IIB string theory explored: Reflection 7-branes

evidence.text: Which type IIB fields acquire periodic or sign-twisted KK spectra in the reflection-brane backgrounds?

sources.title: Interpolated Topology Change in a Spin Cobordism and the Chiral Weyl Curvature Diagnostic

evidence.text: Can smooth Lorentzian spin cobordisms support regulated topology-changing geometries, and can a Weyl-curvature functional distinguish their geometric chirality and supply semiclassical weights?

sources.title: Cobordism Conjecture, Anomalies, and the String Lamppost Principle

evidence.text: Can cobordism triviality and lower-dimensional anomaly cancellation explain gaps in gauge-group ranks, constrain global gauge forms, and support the String Lamppost Principle for theories with sixteen supercharges?

sources.title: Spin-2 spectrum of defect theories

evidence.text: What is the spin-2 spectrum of exact type-IIB interface geometries dual to defect conformal field theories, and can these backgrounds realize the localized-gravity mechanism suggested by the Karch-Randall thin-brane model?

sources.title: R7-branes as charge conjugation operators

evidence.text: Can non-supersymmetric R7-branes predicted by the Cobordism Conjecture implement topological charge conjugation operators in string-engineered QFTs, and can holographic symmetries conversely supply evidence for these branes?

sources.title: Cobordism, singularities and the Ricci flow conjecture

evidence.text: Which compensating manifolds and geometric flows implement bordism trivialization with multiple oriented generators or refined tangential structures?

sources.title: Dynamical Cobordism and the beginning of time: supercritical strings and tachyon condensation

evidence.text: Can the past spacelike singularity of a supercritical timelike linear-dilaton background be understood as a dynamical cobordism boundary, with a microscopic description involving strong-coupling closed-string tachyon condensation?

sources.title: Cobordism, singularities and the Ricci flow conjecture

evidence.text: Can a physical defect replace the bordism contribution of a component removed after geometric surgery?

sources.title: The anomaly that was not meant IIB

evidence.text: Which nontrivial duality backgrounds support the type IIB fermions, including backgrounds without an ordinary Spin structure?

sources.title: Sharpened Dynamical Cobordism

evidence.text: Can the critical exponent of a dynamical-cobordism singularity distinguish an admissible transition to nothing from an obstruction requiring additional fields or defects, through an allowed region determined by the theory's physical structure?

sources.title: What makes spacetime spin in string theory?

evidence.text: Can the spin requirement for type II target spacetimes be derived directly from consistency of the worldsheet GSO projection, and can the same analysis classify orbifold obstructions and worldsheet theta choices?

sources.title: The Chronicles of IIBordia: Dualities, Bordisms, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does the Swampland Cobordism Conjecture recover known type IIB/F-theory defects when duality bundles and fermions are included, and does adding reflections predict new nonperturbative objects?

sources.title: Building blocks for topology change in 3-D

evidence.text: What elementary cobordisms generate topology change in three dimensions, and how might this decomposition organize the sum over topologies in quantum gravity?

sources.title: Comments on summing over bordisms in TQFT

evidence.text: Does the automorphism-weighted sum over bordisms with fixed incoming and outgoing boundaries exist, can it be computed, and when does its total amplitude admit a splitting through an auxiliary inner-product space?

sources.title: Morse-Bott inequalities, topology change and cobordisms to nothing

evidence.text: What does compactification topology force about the homology, intermediate topology changes and defect locations of smoothable bordisms to nothing, including colliding bubbles and intersecting spacetime boundaries?

sources.title: Cobordism, singularities and the Ricci flow conjecture

evidence.text: Can a physically meaningful length on cobordism interpolations replace a singular Ricci-flow path and remove its distance divergence?
